# GNK ASG — AI Functionality Preparation

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Purpose

Prepare the AI layer so it becomes useful, controlled and source-aware before any public activation.

## Main AI functions to prepare

### 1. Portal guide

The AI should help visitors find the right section of the portal:

- finance
- documents
- insights
- markets
- technology
- contact
- public information

### 2. Article assistant

For each future article, the AI can prepare:

- title suggestions
- summary
- key points
- image brief
- short public text
- professional post text
- video brief note
- internal link suggestions

### 3. Document explainer

For public documents, the AI may explain:

- what the document is
- why it matters
- where the source is
- what the reader can verify

It must not invent data or replace the document.

### 4. Publishing quality check

Before publication, the AI should check:

- title clarity
- category
- corporate hierarchy
- personal layer accuracy
- link readiness
- image readiness
- mobile readability
- no placeholder text

### 5. Contact support

After connection, the AI can help draft routine replies and meeting proposals. Sensitive or unclear messages remain for review.

## AI answer rules

- Prefer portal sources and prepared content.
- Say when information is not available.
- Do not invent official statements.
- Do not make binding commitments.
- Do not disclose private data.
- Keep the main story corporate.
- Keep the personal layer accurate and discreet.

## Public labels

Use clear labels when needed:

- AI-assisted explanation
- Source-based context
- Public information
- Review required

## Activation rule

The AI layer starts as an internal assistant. Public activation comes only after source routing, fallback answers and dashboard status are reviewed.
